user.title: Add TENWAYS bicycle
user.description: Select a discovered TENWAYS bike, or enter its Bluetooth address if none is currently visible.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Add TENWAYS bicycle
bluetooth_confirm.description: Add {name}? Values are read; the bike only receives the clock sync and the trip reset, and only when their button is pressed.

error.invalid_address: Enter a valid Bluetooth MAC address.

abort.unsupported_model: {name} is not supported yet ({reason}). A debug log or an HCI capture of the TENWAYS app could help to add it; please open an issue.

init.title: TENWAYS options
init.description: Each poll opens a short BLE connection. The TENWAYS app cannot connect while HA is polling.

data_description.ride_hours_before: Total ride time = this value plus all trips HA has read since. Enter the bike's ride time from before the trip was first cleared, so that the overall average (odometer ÷ total ride time) is right.
data_description.auto_clock: In the same connection as a read: after a daylight saving change, every 90 days, and when first enabled.
data_description.trip_reset: Right after a read, in the same connection, so it works when you ride off at once. The read comes first, so HA keeps every ride; an empty trip is not written. “Each time the bike appears” clears it at every switch-on and when it comes back into range.

state.ride: Each time the bike appears (per ride)

bike_not_in_range.message: The bike is not in Bluetooth range. Switch it on near the adapter or proxy and close the TENWAYS app.

clock_failed.message: Could not set the bike clock: {error}

options.ride: Each time the bike appears (per ride)
